run_parse_tool_A_outputs: run the script to parse MTurk annotation CSV outputs and compute inter-annotator agreements
process_result: process a single MTurk annotation row dict into an action dictionary with word tokens
preprocess_chat: preprocess a chat string by tokenizing and splitting into normalized sentences
process_dict: process a flat key-value dict with dot-separated prefixes into a nested action structure
handle_commands: handle command-type annotations by extracting action type, dialogue type, and child fields
